text.p: Belgian biotechnology firm Innogenetics NV, which is listed on European small cap market Easdaq, said on Monday that turnover jumped to 820 million francs in 1996 from 538 million in 1995 according to provisional figures.

It said it would announce full results at the end of February but that "it is already apparent that the operational as well as the financial profit for 1996 has considerably increased compared to 1995".
Innogenetics, which sells diagnostic tests for diseases such as HIV and Alzheimers, said it increased its market share in diagnostic products. Sales rose to 470 from 378 million francs.
It said that royalties from licensed products and technologies were also very important.
Income from cooperation agreements soared to 200 million francs from 21 million, it said.
